beats.text: Far away, Rama's arrow hit the deer, and it turned back into Maricha, a giant demon falling to the ground.
With his dying breath, he cried out in Rama's voice: 'Sita! Lakshmana! Help me!'
Rama understood the trick at once, and began to run back toward the hut.
At the hut, Sita heard the cry and begged Lakshmana to go. He refused. 'No one in the three worlds can harm Rama.'
Mad with fear, she spoke harsh words. She accused him of wanting Rama dead. Lakshmana covered his ears.
Hurt but obedient, he drew a line around the hut, as later tellings say. 'Do not cross this, whatever happens.'
He bowed to the trees and the forest spirits, and asked them to protect her.
Then he went to find his brother, looking back again and again.
